entries.title: Steel Man Argument - Explained
entries.author: Philosophy Vibe
entries.summary: Argues that the strongest form of disagreement is to improve your opponent's argument before answering it, because defeating a weak version proves nothing. Uses a two-voice dialogue to contrast strawmanning with steelmanning across two worked examples.
